logger.doc:name: Log Processing Wait
logger.message: Waiting for document processing to complete...

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java var stamp = now() as String {format: "yyyyMMddHHmmss", timezone: "UTC"} var jsonString = vars.documentDetails.prompts.Result.answer.value as String // Use read() function to parse JSON string - this handles escaped quotes properly var extractedData = read(jsonString, "application/json") --- { firstName: extractedData.first_name default "Unknown", lastName: extractedData.last_name default "Lead", email: "${default.test.email}" default extractedData.email default "document@aurora.com", postalCode: extractedData.postal_code default "", identifier: extractedData.identifier default "", date: extractedData.date default "", errors: extractedData.errors default {}, timestamp: stamp }

logger.doc:name: Log Errors Found
logger.message: Document processing completed with errors for: #[vars.documentKey] - Errors: #[vars.extractedData.errors]

ee:message.ee:set-payload:
%dw 2.0 output application/java var errorList = vars.extractedData.errors pluck $ joinBy "
• " --- { to: [vars.extractedData.email], subject: "Aurora Mortgage Application - Issues Found", body: "Dear " ++ vars.extractedData.firstName ++ " " ++ vars.extractedData.lastName ++ ",

" ++ "Thank you for submitting your mortgage application. We have processed your document, but we found some issues that need to be addressed:

" ++ "• " ++ errorList ++ "

" ++ "Please review and correct these issues, then resubmit your application. If you have any questions, please contact our support team.

" ++ "Best regards,
" ++ "Aurora Mortgage Team" }
